# `swift` operations

5 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### swift.status

**Swift toolchain**

Report the Swift compiler, installed cross-compilation SDKs and Android NDK.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.status
```

### swift.android_configure

**Connect Swift to the Android NDK**

Run the installed Swift SDK's NDK setup script using the configured ANDROID_NDK_HOME. Required after SDK/NDK installation or relocation.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sdk` | string |  | `""` | Installed Swift Android SDK identifier |

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.android_configure
```

### swift.sdk_install

**Install Swift SDK**

Install a Swift SDK from a local bundle or HTTPS URL with an explicit SHA-256 checksum.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes |  | Local artifactbundle path or HTTPS download URL |
| `checksum` | string |  | `""` | SHA-256; required for remote downloads |

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.sdk_install '{"source":"<source>"}'
```

### swift.plan

**Plan Swift build**

Resolve a native SwiftPM build for Android or Linux. Portable unit tests execute on Linux.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `platform` | string |  | `"android"` | one of `android`, `linux` |
| `architecture` | string |  | `"aarch64"` | one of `aarch64`, `x86_64`, `armv7` |
| `configuration` | string |  | `"debug"` | one of `debug`, `release` |
| `action` | string |  | `"build"` | one of `build`, `test` |
| `sdk` | string |  | `""` | Installed Swift SDK identifier; defaults to configured Android SDK |
| `api_level` | integer |  | `26` | 23 to 37 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.plan '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### swift.execute

**Compile / test Swift**

Compile a Swift package to native code or run its Linux unit tests as a job.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
